title: Underdog AI Releases 163 MB Speech Model Beating OpenAI Whisper
summary:
On-device transcription now requires less than 0.25 seconds to process one minute of audio on a MacBook. The tool, Bark 3.0, is a 163 MB frontier speech model that is 15x smaller than Nvidia's Parakeet and 57x smaller than OpenAI's Whisper large-v3. On a benchmark of recorded meetings (AMI), Bark 3.0 recorded a 7.82% word error rate, outperforming Parakeet at 9.42% and Whisper large-v3 at 13.63%.

Underdog AI released the model under a CC-BY 4.0 open source license for use on laptops and phones. The developers incorporated research from moondreamai into the project, which is now available for private meeting notes and dictation within the Underdog app.
